name: pilot-1
instructions: One row per word; the verdict covers every exercise listed for the word (adding the ending, and dictation). In verdict write one of: ok; critical (with category wrong_answer, ambiguous_answer, misleading_explanation or inappropriate, and a note); minor-keep (a harmless wording or presentation problem; the item stays; note what it is); minor-exclude (a minor problem, but leave the item out; note it). Only words marked ok or minor-keep are approved.
